readout_other: hot-plate and tail-flick tests; sciatic CMAP/MNCV; Western blot (Bcl-2, caspase-3, Parkin); MDA, SOD, IL-1beta, IL-6; LFB histology
direction_notes: US-treated cisplatin rats showed increased motor nerve conduction velocity and CMAP amplitude, shorter nociceptive latencies, and reduced oxidative stress and inflammation relative to untreated cisplatin rats; no US-only or sham-US control.

exposures.label: CP + US (0.5 and 1.5 W/cm2), sciatic nerve

target.label: approximately 5 cm2 skin area above the sciatic nerve on the lateral thigh of each leg

timing.protocol_description: US applied for 3 min onto an approximately 5 cm2 skin area above the sciatic nerve of each leg (both legs), at 1 MHz and 0.5 or 1.5 W/cm2 in a pulsed mode at 20% duty cycle, for 15 consecutive days; rats restrained in prone position.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The rats were randomly divided into 5 experimental groups (10 animals in each group) as control (C), cisplatin administration (CP), 10 mg/kg melatonin treatment (CP + MEL), 1 MHz frequency 0.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> pulsed US treatment (CP + US 0.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup>) and 1 MHz frequency 1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> pulsed US treatment (CP + US 1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup>) groups.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Afterwards, melatonin and low-intensity pulsed low-frequency US treatments were performed for 15 consecutive days (Fig. 1).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The US treatment was applied to both legs (right and left leg) at 1 MHz frequency and a power density of 0.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> and 1.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup> in a pulsed mode at 20% duty cycle for 15 days<sup>32</sup>.

flags.reason: Paper gives only 'power density' of 0.5 and 1.5 W/cm2; whether this is Isppa or Ispta, and in what medium, is not stated. Placed under ispta by choice; treat as metric unknown.
Pulse duration and PRF not stated; only 20% duty cycle.
3 min per leg per day; the 3 min is the restraint and application time, per-leg split not stated.
Only group sizes of the two US groups stated (10 each); total not given.
Therapeutic physiotherapy device, not a TUS neuromodulation system; peripheral nerve treatment of neuropathy.
Paper states no US-applied sham or control groups were included.
